[[Docu Kindleshot]] is a [[Charr]] [[boss]] that appears during [[Blood Washes Blood]]. He also appears in [[Grothmar Wardowns]], but is replaced by [[Chaelse Flameshielder]] after a certain point.

==Locations==
*[[Charr Homelands]]
**{{NPC location|Grothmar Wardowns}} (stops spawning after a certain point)

**{{NPC location|Blood Washes Blood}}

20 Marksmanship in [[Hard mode]]
* {{skill icon|Barrage}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Dual Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Ignite Arrows}}
* {{skill icon|Savage Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}

==Items dropped==
* [[Charr Garment]]

==Notes==
*Like most Ranger [[NPC]]s, this boss will maintain its [[preparation]], thus wasting energy and time to activate Ignite Arrows when using Barrage.
